summary.text: Rafael Wolf is the Libertarian candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Jen Strebs (D) and Nicole Sabel (R); there is no incumbent in the race.
He has been a Libertarian candidate for the Michigan House in 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Wolf was born in Berlin, Germany.
He earned a high school diploma from Arvada West High School and bachelor's degrees from Davenport University and Grace Bible College, both in 2002.
His professional experience includes information technology consulting and adult foster care, and he has been affiliated with Portage Rotary, Buy Local, and Fair Food Matters.
Wolf ran in Michigan House District 63 in 2020, receiving 2.1 percent of the vote in a race won by Matt Hall.
He was the Libertarian candidate in District 41 in 2022, receiving 2.4 percent, and in 2024, again receiving 2.4 percent; Julie Rogers won both elections.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
